### What changed
`_resolve_host_node_binary` now runs `<candidate> --version` once per candidate, requires a Node semver whose major matches `.nvmrc`, rejects mismatches/non-Node (including shell-script impostors), continues PATH → Homebrew `node@{major}` keg → `/opt/homebrew/bin` → `/usr/local/bin` → `~/.hermes/node/bin`, and reuses that absolute path for argv[0] and child PATH.
